description.value: Viet Family is a fully vegan Vietnamese restaurant on Commercial Drive, one of Vancouver's most-cycled urban corridors, established in 2022 by the Ho family and relocated to its current spot in 2024. The menu centres on Vietnamese staples — pho, summer rolls, bún bowls, and dry vermicelli platters — all plant-based and crafted with house-made broths and sauces. The restaurant also offers catering and private event hosting, suggesting a comfortable, full-service dining environment well suited for a group rest stop.
